Page content
Home Intern Details FAQ Contact Us

About Us
NPTEL provides an opportunity to its learners to have research experiences with the faculty from IITs/IISc/IISER/IIIT/other course offering institutes. NPTEL internship opportunities are available under the supervision of the course instructors at the course-offering institutes. The internships are generally offered during the summer (May/Jun/Jul) and winter (Nov/Dec/Jan) semester breaks depending on the availability of resources. The eligible candidates of Jan-Apr semester will be considered for the winter internships, and the eligible candidates of Jul-Oct semesters for the summer internship opportunity. PRE INTERNSHIP DURING THE INTERNSHIP POST INTERNSHIP SAMPLE CERTIFICATE TI INTERNSHIP

Eligibility
NPTEL course toppers and candidates passing the certification exam in the Elite-Gold category are only eligible to apply. The internships will be considered for the Students and Faculty members (as per the profession selected during the course enrolment). The students will be considered for the in-person internships only. Faculty members who cannot avail leave from their workplace and the candidates with disabilities (PwD) will only be
						considered for the virtual internship, wherever feasible.

Duration of internship
Internships can be offered for a period of 2/4/6/8/10/12 weeks duration. The duration will be decided by the course instructor based on the nature of internship related work and the
						availability of other logistics. The tentative start date of internship can be adjusted based on the mutual convenience of the selected candidates and the faculty.

Application Process and Selection
The NPTEL office will contact the course instructor to check if they can take interns from the toppers/Elite-Gold category of learners of their respective courses. Depending on the availability and confirmation from the course instructor, the eligible candidates of those courses where the consent of the faculty has been obtained will be informed
						through email with the detailed application process and the internship schedule. The NPTEL will send the communication in this regard by April for the Summer internships and by October for the Winter internships. The interested eligible candidates are expected to check their academic calendar, get the consent of their college authorities and apply online with the following documents Resume Last 2-semester grade cards Statement of purpose NPTEL course certificate The selection of the candidate will be made by the course instructor based on the documents submitted/personal interview/any other means as it is deemed suitable. The decision of the faculty on the selection process is final and binding on all. The selected candidates will be issued with the offer letters copying their college authorities.

Accommodation
NPTEL will try to arrange for your accommodation at one of the hostels within the institute premises. The local institute guidelines in this regard are binding and the availability of hostel
					accommodation cannot be guaranteed. This factor has to be taken into consideration while applying for the internships. In case of non-availability of in-campus hostel accommodation, the candidate has to arrange for his/her own accommodation outside. The local NPTEL offices at IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, IIT
					Guwahati, IIT Kanpur, IIT Kharagpur, IIT Madras, IIT Roorkee, and IISc Bangalore can assist you in finding suitable outside accommodation, if required. The contact details of the local
					offices will be provided in the internship offer letters. For NPTEL internships at institutes other than those IITs/IISc mentioned above, the selected candidates have to get in touch with the Professor (through official email/phone) for any support
					or make their own arrangements.

Stipend
The stipend for the in-person NPTEL internship has been revised effective from Summer Internship 2025 as per the following details. No stipends are payable for the virtual internship. Duration Stipend amount 2 weeks Rs. 7500/- 4 weeks Rs. 15,000/- 6 weeks Rs. 22,500/- 8 weeks Rs. 30,000/- 10 weeks Rs. 37,500/- 12 weeks Rs. 45,000/- The stipend will be payable on successful completion of the internship.

Welcome to the Internship & Placement Portal
Connecting IIT Guwahati's Data Science & AI talent with industry and academia —
                    student portfolios, internships, and opportunities, all in one place.

Industry minds, in the classroom.
Expert-led sessions bringing real-world DS & AI practice to our students.

For Companies
Post opportunities and find the perfect candidates for your organization.

For Academia
Post academic projects and internships to collaborate with student talent.

For Students
Apply for internships, gain real-world experience, and build your career path. As a key component of the BSc (Hons.) in Data Science and AI program at IIT Guwahati, students undertake
                    internships lasting 3 to 9 months after completing 24 foundational courses covering core concepts in
                    data science, AI, and computational methods. These internships offer students crucial exposure to
                    real-world applications, allowing them to apply their learning in dynamic, data-driven environments
                    — across industry, research labs, and academia. Internship windows: September – November January – March May – July To deepen their contributions, students also have the option to extend their engagement through a
                    12-month capstone project, continuing work on the same or a related problem in collaboration with the
                    host organization. We invite recruiters, startups, research labs, and academic institutions to partner
                    with us in shaping the next generation of data and AI professionals. The BSc (Hons.) in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence offered by IIT Guwahati is a forward-looking
                    undergraduate program designed to build strong foundations in data science, AI, and computational
                    thinking. Delivered in a flexible, online-first format, it blends rigorous academic content with
                    real-world applicability - preparing learners to tackle complex, data-driven challenges across
                    industries. The program has attracted a diverse and growing cohort of over 3,000 students from across India and the
                    globe. With its inclusive and accessible structure, it represents the first-of-its-kind online BSc
                    (Hons.) degree by an IIT, offering a scalable model for future-ready learning. Students benefit from: A curriculum shaped and delivered by IIT faculty and industry leaders Hands-on projects, labs, and case studies Opportunities for internships and capstone projects Access to a vibrant, global peer network

Messages from our leadership
Welcome to the Internship and Placement Portal of IIT Guwahati. We are dedicated to nurturing
                        talent and fostering industry-academia collaboration. This platform is designed to provide
                        students with seamless access to internship opportunities and placement prospects across
                        various domains. This platform bridges students with the academic and industrial world. With hands-on exposure,
                        our students enhance their real-world readiness and make meaningful contributions to society
                        through innovation and collaboration. Our BSc (Hons.) in Data Science and AI students come from diverse academic and professional
                        backgrounds across India and beyond. They bring strong analytical skills, technical expertise,
                        and adaptability. Open to 3-9 month internships and a 1-year capstone extension, they're
                        ready to contribute across domains. We invite recruiters to engage with this dynamic talent pool. At Online Degree Program, IIT Guwahati, we don't just teach-we build minds. Minds trained
                        in analytical and quantitative rigor, sharpened by evidence-based reasoning, and driven by
                        questions that don't settle for easy answers. Same framework. Same faculty. Same standards.
                        No shortcuts. Learners come from everywhere-different paths, different pasts-but
                        they move with the same purpose: to explore, to test, to grow. We invite Recruiters to step in
                        and engage with this talent that is trained to think, built to adapt, and ready to deliver impact. In my role overseeing the internship evaluation process, I have the opportunity to observe every student closely across three internships undertaken with IIT faculty, startups, and industry partners, alongside term projects many students pursue on their own initiative.
                        Each internship concludes with a structured report, a video presentation, and a viva voce—a cycle that reveals far more than academic transcripts do.
                        Through this process, students develop the ability to document their work rigorously, articulate their contributions clearly, and defend their reasoning under direct questioning.
                        One observation stands out consistently: academic grades show little correlation with a student's actual performance during internships. It is consistency of engagement, curiosity, and growth across these cycles—including the projects they choose to pursue independently—that truly distinguishes our learners.
